crew.overview: Inspired by true events, this film takes place in Rwanda in the 1990s when more than a million Tutsis were killed in a genocide that went mostly unnoticed by the rest of the world. Hotel owner Paul Rusesabagina houses over a thousand refuges in his hotel in attempt to save their lives.
crew.title: Hotel Rwanda

details.biography: Martin Katz is a Canadian film and television producer. He holds degrees in law from the University of Toronto and the Université de Paris I (Panthéon-Sorbonne). Katz is founder of the Toronto-based film and television production company  Prospero Pictures.
details.name: Martin Katz
